extension-build.description: Builds the Blender extension archives the project's blender_manifest.toml declares through Blender's blender_ext.py, with no Blender installed, one archive per platform the manifest lists and one for every platform where it lists none, or for a check validates the manifest and files of the source folder with blender_ext.py validate; a project holding pyproject.toml builds one staged copy per platform the manifest lists, or one for every platform where it lists none, that bundles its local dependencies as subpackages and as wheels the registry dependencies uv installs from the exported lock for its platforms at the one Python minor its requires-python pins as ==<major>.<minor>.*, leaving out each package its blender dependency group pins as one Blender bundles

package.description: Packs each host package the project's other builds wrote, else its tracked source folder: a .ccx zip for an Adobe UXP manifest.json, a .zip for a Chrome Manifest V3 manifest.json, a .yak through yak build for a manifest.yml

install.description: Installs what the project's build wrote in the run's configuration where its host loads it: each package built for this platform through the host's own installer, or the unpacked build folder for a host loading one

release-publish.description: Publishes each host package the target's dependency targets wrote to its host's store through the store's own upload, where the credential variable is set, the store lacks that version, and the checked-out commit holds the project's tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, and names the missing variable, tag, or the first upload a store takes by hand alone, where it is not; runs through nx release publish, a dry run previewing every project

unreal-build.description: Builds a .uproject's editor target through UnrealBuildTool, with its Clang static analyzer, unity builds off, and no precompiled headers for a check, or for a .uplugin packages it through AutomationTool's BuildPlugin with strict includes once per engine on this machine its hosts name, skipping a host whose engine is absent, after each package its descriptor maps to a folder installs there under a .gitignore holding *, runs the automation tests named after it through UnrealEditor-Cmd in each host and reads their result from the exported report, zips the tracked sources with those installed packages and the engine's EngineVersion once per engine after the Fab store checks pass, or copies the package into the Plugins folder of each user project

clean.description: Runs the tool's own clean commands when given, then removes the outputs the named targets of the project declare, keeping any the workspace tracks as source, and empties the named folders

upgrade.description: Runs a tool's upgrade commands in order, and under a dry run each command's own dry run in its place, printing a command without one

publish.description: Delivers the files a project's packaging targets wrote to its registry or store through its tool's own publish command where the destination's credential is set and the checked-out commit holds the project's tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, and names the missing variable or tag where it is not; runs through nx release publish, a dry run previewing every project

attach.description: Uploads the files a project's packaging targets wrote to the GitHub release of the project's tag at the checked-out commit through gh release upload --clobber, the tag nx release made from release.releaseTag.pattern, and uploads nothing where nx release released no version of the project at that commit, a dry run previewing every project
